name: knovid
description: KnoVid — video to knowledge: transcripts, speaker labels, knowledge graphs, notes, quizzes, and Q&A

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,processor,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:processor" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:processor: node scripts/python.js -m uvicorn --app-dir processing-service main:app --reload --port 8000 --env-file processing-service/.env
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:python: cd processing-service && node ../scripts/python.js -m pip install --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt
